name: gatewerk
description: The open-source review layer for AI agents. Work done for humans is decided by humans.
long_description: Gatewerk is one inbox where agent actions stop and wait for a person. This MCP server exposes Gatewerk's review, template, feedback, audit, chain, and note APIs as tools: create reviews, submit decisions, query feedback memory, and manage templates against your own self-hosted Gatewerk instance. Reviews are typed forms with inline editing, and every decision lands in a tamper evident, HMAC chained audit log.

gatewerk_url.title: Gatewerk URL
gatewerk_url.description: The base URL of your Gatewerk instance.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: A Gatewerk API key (gwk_...). Create one in your Gatewerk instance under Settings, API Keys.

reviewer.description: Optional name recorded as the reviewer on decisions made through this server.
